dataset.note: Synthetic/controlled dataset used for model development and evaluation: 200 AI-generated seed complaints and 400 AI paraphrases. No real student complaints.

protocol.selection: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold on train+val (paraphrase groups never split)
protocol.test: original held-out test split, used once for every model
protocol.calibration: temperature scaling fitted on out-of-fold scores
protocol.threshold_rule: lowest threshold at which category and priority are each correct >= 75% out of fold among complaints at or above it (coverage >= 10%)

models.keyword_baseline: Hand-written keyword lexicon, most hits wins (no training)
models.word_lr: TF-IDF word 1-2 grams + Logistic Regression (v1 configuration)
models.word_char_lr_C1: TF-IDF word 1-2 + char 2-5 grams + Logistic Regression (C=1)
models.word_char_lr_C5: TF-IDF word 1-2 + char 2-5 grams + Logistic Regression (C=5)
models.word_char_svm: TF-IDF word 1-2 + char 2-5 grams + Linear SVM
models.hybrid_kw_lr_C5: TF-IDF word + char + keyword-count features + Logistic Regression (C=5)

threshold.rule: lowest threshold at which category and priority are each correct >= 75% out of fold among complaints at or above it (coverage >= 10%)

typo_noise_test.description: Same 90 test texts with deterministic spelling noise (dropped/swapped/doubled letters)

probes.description: Author-written probe texts (not dataset records, not used for accuracy). Desired behaviour: sent to human review.
